headline: Apple Sports adds Grand Slam tennis draws and expands soccer coverage
summary: The Apple Sports app is enhancing its offerings with real-time Grand Slam tournament draws and more detailed soccer coverage for fans.
details: Apple Sports is rolling out new features to enhance its sports coverage. Tennis fans can now follow real-time Grand Slam draws, providing up-to-the-minute updates on major tournaments.
In addition to tennis, the app is also expanding its soccer coverage. This update aims to provide a more comprehensive experience for users interested in following their favorite teams and players.

The enhancements reflect Apple's ongoing effort to build out its sports ecosystem, integrating with Apple TV+ and other services to offer a seamless viewing and tracking experience for sports enthusiasts.
caption:
Apple Sports is stepping up its game with new features for tennis and soccer fans.

Apple Sports is rolling out new features to enhance its sports coverage. Tennis fans can now follow real-time Grand Slam draws, providing up-to-the-minute updates on major tournaments.

In addition to tennis, the app is also expanding its soccer coverage. This update aims to provide a more comprehensive experience for users interested in following their favorite teams and players.

The enhancements reflect Apple's ongoing effort to build out its sports ecosystem, integrating with Apple TV+ and other services to offer a seamless viewing and tracking experience for sports enthusiasts.
